top_five.title: Camera clock/timebase audit (12:44 vs 12:23 discrepancy)
top_five.rationale: Resolving the clock discrepancy is the foundation for every other timeline-dependent finding in the case; until every camera's timebase is calibrated to a common reference, no cross-camera identification or sequencing claim can be considered reliable.

top_five.title: Early-morning UVU visit reconstruction
top_five.rationale: A verified early-morning campus visit, if established, would be the strongest evidence of reconnaissance or pre-positioning, and its route and dwell points could reveal equipment staging locations not otherwise documented.

top_five.title: Raw surveillance continuity analysis
top_five.rationale: Continuous, unedited coverage across the full camera ecosystem is what makes it possible to assert that the morning subject, rooftop subject, and fleeing subject are the same person; any undocumented gap undermines that chain.

top_five.title: Native digital-message evidence and note provenance
top_five.rationale: Native, forensically extracted messages and a fully authenticated handwritten note are far more probative than screenshots or summaries, and their provenance directly bears on both identification and motive.

top_five.title: Physical correlation matrix
top_five.rationale: Cross-referencing DNA, fibers, footwear, palm print, and tool marks across every recovered item into a single matrix is the clearest way to test whether the physical evidence points consistently to one individual or contains unexplained outliers.

biometric_control.concept: Use the early-morning UVU footage as an internal biometric control
biometric_control.description: Because the early-morning campus visit, the later daytime sighting, the rooftop subject, and the fleeing subject were all potentially captured on the same camera ecosystem within the same day, the morning footage can serve as an internal biometric 'control' sample. Rather than relying on external reference photos or documents, each subsequent sighting can be measured directly against the morning-visit subject using the same cameras, lighting conditions, and lens geometry, minimizing cross-source calibration error.

comparison_chain.subject: morning subject
comparison_chain.description: Baseline biometric reference captured during the early-morning UVU visit.

comparison_chain.subject: later subject
comparison_chain.description: Daytime sighting compared against the morning baseline for height, build, and gait.

comparison_chain.subject: rooftop subject
comparison_chain.description: Subject captured at the firing position compared against the morning baseline and later sighting.

comparison_chain.subject: fleeing subject
comparison_chain.description: Subject captured departing the scene compared against all prior sightings to close the identity chain.

biometric_control.value: If the same camera ecosystem and same-day conditions hold across all four sightings, this comparison chain removes most of the cross-source variability that normally weakens photo/video identification, making it one of the highest-value analytical opportunities in the case.

items.title: Camera clock/timebase audit (12:44 vs 12:23 discrepancy)
items.detail: Audit the internal clocks and timebases of every camera system that captured relevant footage to resolve the reported 12:44 vs 12:23 timestamp discrepancy, establishing a single authoritative timeline for the day's events.

items.title: Cross-camera clock synchronization and NTP/DVR drift verification
items.detail: Verify NTP synchronization status and DVR/NVR clock drift for every camera system involved (campus, retail, municipal, private) to determine how far each system's displayed timestamp deviates from true time.

items.title: Early-morning UVU visit — arrival and route reconstruction
items.detail: Reconstruct the subject's arrival at Utah Valley University in the early morning hours, including vehicle/foot route taken, entry points used, and cameras that captured the approach.

items.title: Early-morning UVU visit — dwell-point and duration analysis
items.detail: Map every location the subject stopped or lingered at during the early-morning campus visit, with duration at each point, to identify reconnaissance behavior or equipment staging.

items.title: Backpack first-appearance and chain-of-custody tracking
items.detail: Trace the first camera appearance of the backpack associated with the subject and track its custody/handling across every subsequent frame in which it appears, including any hand-offs or changes in who is carrying it.

items.title: Backpack contents and carry-posture inference across frames
items.detail: Analyze carrying posture, sag, and silhouette of the backpack across available frames to infer approximate contents, weight distribution, and whether contents changed between sightings.

items.title: Chick-fil-A purchase record cross-reference
items.detail: Obtain and cross-reference point-of-sale/purchase records from the Chick-fil-A location tied to the timeline against the subject's claimed movements to corroborate or contradict the established schedule.

items.title: Chick-fil-A drive-thru camera acquisition and clock audit
items.detail: Acquire raw drive-thru and lot camera footage from the Chick-fil-A location and audit its internal clock against the master timeline established in the camera clock/timebase audit.

items.title: Surveillance continuity and coverage-gap analysis
items.detail: Map every camera's field of view along the subject's reconstructed path to identify continuous coverage versus blind spots, flagging any gap during which the subject could have altered appearance, equipment, or route undetected.

items.title: Surveillance camera-to-camera handoff verification
items.detail: Verify that the subject identified exiting one camera's field of view is the same subject entering the next camera's field of view at each handoff point, closing any identity-continuity gaps.

items.title: Original/unenhanced footage acquisition request
items.detail: Formally request the original, unenhanced, uncompressed source files for all released footage, since publicly circulated clips are often re-encoded, cropped, or frame-rate-converted in ways that can distort timestamps and detail.

items.title: Footage chain-of-custody audit — released versus original
items.detail: Compare every publicly released or discovery-produced clip against the original source file to document any cropping, transcoding, frame drops, or metadata stripping introduced during processing.

items.title: Photogrammetry-based height and build estimation
items.detail: Apply photogrammetric analysis using known fixed reference points in each camera's frame to estimate the height, build, and stride length of the subject captured on the morning, rooftop, and fleeing footage.

items.title: Gait analysis — morning, rooftop, and fleeing subject comparison
items.detail: Conduct a comparative gait analysis across the morning-visit subject, the rooftop subject, and the fleeing subject captured on the same camera ecosystem to test whether all three represent a single consistent individual.

items.title: Timestamp discrepancy resolution across agency releases
items.detail: Reconcile conflicting timestamps between footage and documents released by different agencies (campus police, local PD, FBI) to produce one internally consistent master chronology.

items.title: Spanish Fork encounter reconstruction
items.detail: Reconstruct the reported Spanish Fork encounter in detail, including precise location, time, parties involved, and how it connects to the broader movement timeline of the day.

items.title: Vehicle telematics, infotainment, and GPS data extraction
items.detail: Extract infotainment system logs, telematics data, and GPS history from any vehicle tied to the subject to independently corroborate the movement timeline.

items.title: ALPR hit analysis along travel corridors
items.detail: Pull automated license plate reader (ALPR) hits along all plausible travel corridors for the day to independently verify vehicle location and timing against the camera-based timeline.

items.title: Gas station purchase and fuel receipt timeline
items.detail: Collect fuel purchase receipts and associated station camera footage to place the vehicle at specific times and locations throughout the day.

items.title: Odometer and mileage reconciliation
items.detail: Reconcile the vehicle's odometer readings against the claimed travel distances and route to check for consistency with the reconstructed timeline.

items.title: Palm print recovery and comparison analysis
items.detail: Analyze the recovered palm print for quality, completeness, and comparison methodology used to match it to the suspect, including an independent review of the point-of-comparison chart.

items.title: Palm print substrate and surface suitability audit
items.detail: Assess whether the surface the palm print was recovered from was forensically suitable for reliable print development and whether alternate light source or chemical processing was properly documented.

items.title: Sniper pad (shooting mat/rest) material and origin analysis
items.detail: Analyze the material composition, manufacturer, and likely point of origin of the shooting pad/mat recovered at the firing position.

items.title: Sniper pad fiber and trace comparison to suspect's belongings
items.detail: Compare fibers and trace material recovered from the shooting pad against fibers from clothing and belongings attributed to the suspect.

items.title: Roof substrate disturbance mapping
items.detail: Map disturbances to the gravel, membrane, or other roof substrate at the firing position to reconstruct shooter positioning, movement, and dwell time.

items.title: Roof substrate trace evidence collection audit
items.detail: Audit how trace evidence (fibers, residue, prints) was collected from the roof substrate, including whether the full firing-position area was processed or only a limited zone.

items.title: Footwear impression comparison
items.detail: Compare footwear impressions recovered at the scene against shoes attributed to the suspect, including tread pattern, size, and wear-pattern analysis.

items.title: Footwear-to-shoe-collection database cross-reference
items.detail: Cross-reference the recovered footwear impression against manufacturer tread databases to independently verify brand/model identification claims.

items.title: Landing/jump biomechanics reconstruction (roof egress)
items.detail: Reconstruct the biomechanics of the shooter's egress from the roof, including estimated jump/drop height, landing point, and resulting impact forces.

items.title: Landing-point trauma correlation with rooftop height
items.detail: Correlate any injuries attributed to the suspect with the estimated rooftop egress height to test physical plausibility of the claimed escape method.

items.title: Medical history review — biomechanics-relevant prior injuries
items.detail: Review the suspect's medical history for prior injuries that would affect gait, jump capability, or physical performance relevant to the reconstructed events.

items.title: Medical and psychiatric history relevant to capability determination
items.detail: Review available medical and psychiatric history relevant to assessing physical and mental capability to plan and execute the events described.

items.title: Rifle make, model, and serial provenance
items.detail: Trace the full ownership and possession chain of the recovered rifle by serial number, from manufacture through point of sale to recovery.

items.title: Scope/optic calibration and mounting analysis
items.detail: Analyze the scope or optic recovered with the rifle for calibration accuracy, mounting integrity, and consistency with the claimed firing position and target distance.

items.title: DNA matrix — full profile comparison across all recovered items
items.detail: Build a full DNA comparison matrix across every item recovered from the scene, rifle, pad, clothing, and vehicle to map whose DNA appears where.

items.title: DNA matrix — mixture and partial profile statistical analysis
items.detail: Independently review the statistical methodology used to interpret any mixed or partial DNA profiles recovered from key items.

items.title: Evidence collection procedure and technician log audit
items.detail: Audit scene technician logs and evidence collection procedures for completeness, sequencing, and adherence to protocol at each stage of processing.

items.title: Screwdriver/rotary tool provenance and tool-mark analysis
items.detail: Trace the provenance of the screwdriver or rotary tool recovered in connection with the case and conduct tool-mark analysis against any tool marks found at the scene.

items.title: Cartridge case vs. recovered bullet consistency analysis
items.detail: Independently verify that the recovered cartridge cases are consistent with the recovered bullet(s) in caliber, rifling characteristics, and firing sequence.

items.title: Cartridge case headstamp and manufacturer identification
items.detail: Identify the headstamp markings on recovered cartridge cases to confirm manufacturer, caliber, and likely production batch.

items.title: ATF firearms/toolmark examiner worksheet review
items.detail: Obtain and independently review the ATF firearms and toolmark examiner's bench worksheets underlying the official ballistics conclusions.

items.title: ATF NIBIN entry and correlation check
items.detail: Check whether the recovered cartridge cases were entered into NIBIN and review any correlation hits against other cases or firearms.

items.title: 3D microscopic toolmark comparison — breech face and firing pin
items.detail: Commission an independent 3D microscopic comparison of breech-face and firing-pin impressions to verify the match to the recovered rifle.

items.title: 3D comparison of rifling and land-and-groove characteristics
items.detail: Conduct an independent 3D land-and-groove comparison between the recovered bullet and test-fired rounds from the rifle.

items.title: Ammunition lot number tracing to point of sale
items.detail: Trace the ammunition lot number on recovered and unfired rounds to distributor and retail point-of-sale records.

items.title: Ammunition lot — unfired round comparison
items.detail: Compare unfired rounds recovered from the scene or suspect's possession against the fired cartridge cases for lot consistency.

items.title: Engraving/inscription analysis on unfired cartridges
items.detail: Document and analyze any engravings or inscriptions found on unfired cartridges, including method of engraving and tool used.

items.title: Engraving translation and symbolic-meaning assessment
items.detail: Obtain independent expert translation and cultural/subcultural context analysis for any engraved text or symbols found on cartridges.

items.title: Bullet path/trajectory rod reconstruction at scene
items.detail: Independently review the trajectory-rod reconstruction performed at the scene, including angle measurements and reference points used.

items.title: Bullet path — angle-of-incidence vs. rooftop position modeling
items.detail: Model the angle of incidence of the fatal shot against the geometry of the claimed rooftop firing position to test physical consistency.

items.title: Acoustic gunshot localization via audio/video sync triangulation
items.detail: Use synchronized audio tracks from multiple video sources to triangulate the origin point of the gunshot(s) independent of the visually identified firing position.

items.title: Native/unaltered text and SMS message extraction and metadata audit
items.detail: Obtain native, forensically extracted text/SMS messages (not screenshots or summaries) along with full metadata to verify authenticity, sender/recipient, and timestamps.

items.title: iMessage/encrypted chat provenance verification
items.detail: Verify the extraction methodology and provenance chain for any iMessage or encrypted chat content introduced as evidence.

items.title: Discord direct-message records acquisition
items.detail: Obtain Discord's own server-side records of direct messages attributed to the suspect, rather than relying solely on client-side screenshots.

items.title: Discord server/channel activity history
items.detail: Pull complete server and channel activity history for any Discord accounts attributed to the suspect, including message edit/delete logs.

items.title: Discord account creation and login IP history
items.detail: Obtain account creation records and login IP history for the Discord account(s) in question to verify ownership and usage patterns.

items.title: Handwritten note — handwriting exemplar comparison
items.detail: Commission an independent forensic handwriting comparison between the note in evidence and verified exemplars of the suspect's handwriting.

items.title: Handwritten note — paper and ink forensic analysis
items.detail: Conduct forensic analysis of the paper stock and ink used on the handwritten note to establish likely source and age.

items.title: Handwritten note — chain of custody and discovery-location documentation
items.detail: Document the precise location, condition, and discovery circumstances of the handwritten note, and audit its chain of custody from discovery to analysis.

items.title: Browser history extraction — search queries and visited URLs
items.detail: Extract full browser history, including search queries and visited URLs, from all devices attributed to the suspect.

items.title: Search history — pre-incident research pattern analysis
items.detail: Analyze the pattern and timing of pre-incident search activity to assess planning, research, or reconnaissance behavior.

items.title: Cellular tower/cell-site location chronology
items.detail: Build a cell-site location chronology from carrier records to independently corroborate the suspect's movements throughout the relevant period.

items.title: Cellular — call detail record (CDR) timeline
items.detail: Obtain and analyze call detail records to build a timeline of calls, durations, and contacted parties around the incident.

items.title: Cellular — device provisioning and carrier account history
items.detail: Review device provisioning records and carrier account history to verify device ownership and continuity of use.

items.title: Wi-Fi access-point association log analysis
items.detail: Analyze Wi-Fi access-point association logs from relevant venues and networks to place devices at specific locations and times.

items.title: Wi-Fi probe request history for device presence timeline
items.detail: Use Wi-Fi probe request logs, where available, to establish a device presence timeline even when the device did not fully connect to a network.

items.title: Bluetooth pairing/proximity log analysis
items.detail: Analyze Bluetooth pairing and proximity logs from relevant devices to establish device-to-device contact and location history.

items.title: Bluetooth device-to-device contact history cross-reference
items.detail: Cross-reference Bluetooth contact history against the reconstructed movement timeline to identify corroborating or contradicting device encounters.

items.title: Clothing item identification — rooftop subject vs. later subject
items.detail: Compare clothing items worn by the rooftop subject against clothing worn by the subject captured in later footage to test whether they are the same garments.

items.title: Clothing identification — color/pattern frame-by-frame comparison
items.detail: Conduct a frame-by-frame color and pattern comparison of clothing across all camera sightings, accounting for lighting variation between cameras.

items.title: Retail purchase history for identified clothing items
items.detail: Trace retail purchase records for the specific clothing items identified, including store, date, and payment method.

items.title: Retail purchase history — payment method and receipt tracing
items.detail: Trace the payment method used for identified clothing purchases back to the account holder and cross-reference with financial records.

items.title: Fabric weave/material comparison analysis
items.detail: Conduct a forensic fabric weave and material composition comparison between recovered clothing and items purchased or attributed to the suspect.

items.title: Fabric trace-fiber transfer comparison to recovered items
items.detail: Compare trace fibers recovered from the rifle, pad, and scene against the fabric composition of clothing attributed to the suspect.

items.title: Rifle-in-pants concealment reenactment (feasibility test)
items.detail: Conduct a physical reenactment to test the feasibility of concealing the recovered rifle in the manner alleged, including fit, weight, and visibility.

items.title: Rifle-in-pants — gait/movement impact assessment
items.detail: Assess how concealing the rifle as alleged would affect gait and movement, and compare that predicted gait signature against the gait analysis from Tier 1.

items.title: Disguise/appearance-change timeline across camera sightings
items.detail: Build a timeline of any appearance changes (clothing, headwear, accessories) across all camera sightings of the subject throughout the day.

items.title: Clothing change location and disposal-site analysis
items.detail: Identify the likely location(s) where clothing changes occurred and analyze any associated disposal site for discarded items.

items.title: Scene access log — full roster of personnel entering perimeter
items.detail: Obtain the complete roster of every individual who entered the scene perimeter, with entry and exit times, from first responder arrival forward.

items.title: Scene access log — timestamp cross-check against camera footage
items.detail: Cross-check the scene access log against available camera footage to verify accuracy and identify any undocumented entries.

items.title: Rifle discovery — precise location and discovery-method documentation
items.detail: Document the precise location, position, and method by which the rifle was discovered, including who found it and under what circumstances.

items.title: Rifle discovery — discovering officer's report and body-cam review
items.detail: Review the discovering officer's written report and any body-worn camera footage covering the moment of discovery for consistency with the official account.

items.title: Evidence chain-of-custody — item-by-item tracking log
items.detail: Build an item-by-item chain-of-custody log for every piece of physical evidence from collection through final disposition.

items.title: Evidence chain-of-custody — gap/anomaly identification
items.detail: Identify any gaps, unexplained delays, or handling anomalies in the chain-of-custody records for key evidence items.

items.title: Unrelated firearm recovered at scene — provenance and relevance assessment
items.detail: Assess the provenance and relevance of any additional, seemingly unrelated firearm recovered at or near the scene.

items.title: Unrelated firearm — exclusion/inclusion ballistics testing
items.detail: Conduct ballistics testing on any unrelated firearm to formally exclude or include it from the ballistics picture.

items.title: Unrelated bullet/fragment — origin and relevance assessment
items.detail: Assess the origin and forensic relevance of any bullet or fragment recovered that does not match the primary ballistics narrative.

items.title: Unrelated bullet — trajectory exclusion analysis
items.detail: Conduct trajectory analysis on any unrelated bullet/fragment to determine whether it can be formally excluded from the incident.

items.title: Maintenance/facilities rooftop access authorization log
items.detail: Obtain the facilities/maintenance authorization log for rooftop access, including who was authorized to be on the roof and when.

items.title: Maintenance access — key/badge audit trail for roof-access points
items.detail: Audit the key or badge-access trail for all roof-access points to determine who physically accessed the roof in the relevant time window.

items.title: Witness location mapping
items.detail: Map the precise physical location of every identified witness relative to the scene at the time of the incident.

items.title: Witness sightline/visibility analysis from mapped positions
items.detail: Analyze the sightline and visibility each mapped witness would have had to the firing position and subject, accounting for obstructions and distance.

items.title: Early witness statements — first-report content audit
items.detail: Audit the content of the earliest witness statements taken, before any potential cross-contamination from media coverage or other witnesses.

items.title: Early statements — comparison to later/revised statements
items.detail: Compare each witness's earliest statement against any later or revised statements to identify shifts, additions, or inconsistencies.

items.title: Blind description matrix — physical description consistency
items.detail: Build a matrix comparing physical descriptions given independently by each witness before descriptions were shared or publicized, to test consistency.

items.title: Blind description matrix — clothing description consistency
items.detail: Build a matrix comparing clothing descriptions given independently by each witness before public release of clothing details.

items.title: Witness statement — law-enforcement interview timing log
items.detail: Document the timing of each witness's formal law-enforcement interview relative to the incident and to any public information releases.

items.title: Witness credibility — vantage point and distance assessment
items.detail: Assess each witness's vantage point, distance, and environmental conditions at the time of observation as a credibility factor.

items.title: 911 call transcript and timeline cross-reference
items.detail: Obtain 911 call transcripts and cross-reference their timestamps and content against the master incident timeline.

items.title: Witness statement — media interview vs. official statement comparison
items.detail: Compare statements witnesses gave to media outlets against their official law-enforcement statements for consistency.

items.title: TPUSA event advance packet acquisition
items.detail: Obtain the full event advance packet prepared by or for Turning Point USA ahead of the event, including venue logistics and security planning documents.

items.title: Advance packet — security recommendations vs. implementation gap analysis
items.detail: Compare the security recommendations documented in the advance packet against what was actually implemented on event day to identify gaps.

items.title: Advance packet — venue diagram and rooftop coverage assessment
items.detail: Review venue diagrams included in the advance packet to assess whether the rooftop firing position was identified as a vulnerability during planning.

items.title: Security walk-through report — pre-event inspection findings
items.detail: Obtain the pre-event security walk-through report and review its findings against the eventual firing position.

items.title: Security walk-through — rooftop/elevated-position assessment
items.detail: Determine whether the pre-event walk-through specifically assessed rooftop or other elevated positions overlooking the venue.

items.title: Security walk-through — sign-off and approval chain
items.detail: Trace the sign-off and approval chain for the security plan to identify who approved the final security posture.

items.title: Staffing map — assigned personnel positions at event time
items.detail: Obtain the staffing map showing exactly where each assigned security and law-enforcement person was positioned at the time of the incident.

items.title: Staffing map — rooftop/perimeter coverage staffing levels
items.detail: Assess staffing levels assigned to rooftop and perimeter coverage relative to the overall security plan.

items.title: Staffing map — private security vs. law-enforcement jurisdiction boundaries
items.detail: Document jurisdictional boundaries between private security and law enforcement as reflected in the staffing map.

items.title: Event vendor and credentialing list cross-reference
items.detail: Cross-reference the event vendor and credentialing list against individuals identified in scene-access logs and camera footage.

items.title: Pre-event threat assessment documentation
items.detail: Obtain any pre-event threat assessment documentation prepared by event organizers or law enforcement.

items.title: Communications plan — radio channel and coordination log
items.detail: Obtain the event-day communications plan and radio traffic log to reconstruct real-time coordination during the incident.

items.title: Metal detector/screening checkpoint coverage map
items.detail: Map the coverage and staffing of metal-detector and screening checkpoints relative to all venue entry points.

items.title: Rooftop access control — event-day authorization list
items.detail: Obtain the event-day authorization list specifically governing who could access the rooftop area.

items.title: Post-event after-action report review
items.detail: Review the post-event after-action report prepared by security or law enforcement for findings on what failed and why.

items.title: Autopsy report — full findings review
items.detail: Obtain and independently review the complete autopsy report, including all findings, not just the summary cause-of-death statement.

items.title: Autopsy — cause and manner of death documentation audit
items.detail: Audit the documentation supporting the stated cause and manner of death for completeness and internal consistency.

items.title: Wound angle/trajectory analysis
items.detail: Independently analyze the wound angle documented in the autopsy to determine the trajectory of the projectile through the body.

items.title: Wound angle — consistency with claimed shooter position
items.detail: Test whether the documented wound angle is geometrically consistent with the claimed rooftop shooter position and victim posture.

items.title: Victim posture at time of impact — reconstruction
items.detail: Reconstruct the victim's body posture and orientation at the moment of impact using video, witness, and forensic evidence.

items.title: Posture reconstruction — stage/platform height correlation
items.detail: Correlate the reconstructed victim posture with the stage or platform height and position at the time of the shot.

items.title: Fragment pattern analysis — bullet/bone fragment dispersal
items.detail: Analyze the dispersal pattern of bullet and bone fragments to corroborate or challenge the reconstructed trajectory.

items.title: Fragment pattern — recovery location mapping
items.detail: Map the precise recovery location of every fragment collected as evidence relative to the victim's position.

items.title: Entrance/exit wound characteristic documentation
items.detail: Document entrance and exit wound characteristics in detail, including size, shape, and stippling, to support independent trajectory analysis.

items.title: Medical examiner testimony cross-reference with ballistics findings
items.detail: Cross-reference medical examiner testimony and reports against the independent ballistics and trajectory findings for consistency.

items.title: Digital chronology — comprehensive pre-incident activity timeline
items.detail: Build a comprehensive pre-incident digital activity timeline spanning messaging, browsing, and social media across all identified accounts and devices.

items.title: Digital chronology — ideology exposure timeline
items.detail: Map the timeline of the suspect's exposure to relevant ideological or political content across platforms in the lead-up to the incident.

items.title: Political motive test — statements and affiliations review
items.detail: Review documented statements, affiliations, and associations attributed to the suspect to test the strength of the claimed political motive.

items.title: Political motive test — alternative motive hypothesis testing
items.detail: Systematically test alternative motive hypotheses (personal, financial, psychological, coerced) against the same evidence base used to support the political motive.

items.title: Inscription analysis — cartridge engraving meaning and context
items.detail: Analyze the meaning and context of any engraved text or symbols on cartridges in connection with the asserted motive.

items.title: Inscription analysis — cross-reference to online communities and subculture
items.detail: Cross-reference engraved phrases or symbols against known online communities, memes, or subcultures to establish likely origin and intended audience.

items.title: Motive — relationship and personal history review
items.detail: Review the suspect's personal relationships and history for factors that could independently explain or contribute to motive.

items.title: Weather conditions at time of incident
items.detail: Document precise weather conditions (visibility, precipitation, lighting) at the incident time and location using meteorological records.

items.title: Weather — wind effect on trajectory modeling
items.detail: Incorporate wind speed and direction data into the independent trajectory modeling to assess its effect on the bullet's path.

items.title: Sun position/glare analysis for shooter sightline
items.detail: Calculate sun position at the time of the incident and analyze potential glare effects on the shooter's sightline from the rooftop position.

items.title: Sun position — camera exposure and visibility impact assessment
items.detail: Assess how sun position and resulting camera exposure conditions affected the visibility and identifiability of subjects in the footage.

items.title: Shadow analysis for subject identification timing
items.detail: Use shadow length and direction visible in footage to independently verify the time of day for key frames.

items.title: Shadow-length time-of-day cross-verification
items.detail: Cross-verify shadow-length-derived timestamps against the camera clock/timebase audit findings from Tier 1 to check for consistency.

items.title: Ambient sound analysis — gunshot acoustic signature
items.detail: Analyze the acoustic signature of the gunshot(s) captured on ambient audio to assess consistency with the claimed firearm and distance.

items.title: Ambient sound — crowd noise and reaction timing correlation
items.detail: Correlate the timing of crowd noise and reaction captured on ambient audio with the moment of the shot to refine the master timeline.

items.title: Master exhibit inventory — complete evidence catalog
items.detail: Compile a complete master inventory of every exhibit and piece of evidence generated in the case, cross-referenced to its source report.

items.title: Exhibit inventory — chain-of-custody cross-check
items.detail: Cross-check every exhibit in the master inventory against its chain-of-custody documentation to confirm unbroken tracking.

items.title: Exhibit inventory — missing/unaccounted item audit
items.detail: Audit the master inventory for any evidence items referenced in reports but not accounted for in the physical or digital exhibit record.

items.title: Disclosure anomalies — discovery timeline versus production log
items.detail: Compare the discovery/disclosure timeline against the actual production log of documents and evidence to identify delays or irregular sequencing.

items.title: Disclosure anomalies — redaction pattern review
items.detail: Review redaction patterns across produced documents to identify what categories of information have been consistently withheld.

items.title: Disclosure anomalies — withheld exhibit identification
items.detail: Identify exhibits referenced in reports or testimony that have not been produced, and document the basis given for withholding them.

items.title: Cross-examination index — witness inconsistency catalog
items.detail: Build an index cataloging every identified inconsistency across witness statements for use in cross-examination preparation.

items.title: Cross-examination index — expert testimony vulnerability mapping
items.detail: Map potential vulnerabilities in each expert witness's methodology and conclusions for cross-examination preparation.

items.title: Cross-examination index — timeline contradiction index
items.detail: Build an index of every identified contradiction in the official timeline, cross-referenced to its supporting source document.

items.title: Preservation order compliance audit
items.detail: Audit compliance with any evidence preservation order, including verification that all relevant original digital and physical evidence has been preserved unaltered.
